items.title: Gain per-developer visibility into Kiro Enterprise credit usage
items.summary: In this post, we introduce the Kiro Cost Optimizer, an open-source, serverless solution that gives you per-developer visibility into Kiro Enterprise credit usage. It ingests Kiro's daily per-user activity reports, accumulates month-to-date usage per developer, and delivers a consolidated usage visibility report with tier optimization recommendations via email on a schedule you control. The entire stack deploys in minutes with a single AWS CloudFormation template, costs less than a few dollars a year to operate, and requires zero ongoing maintenance.
items.creator: Rob Yang
